title: iac-stack-template services.yml
description: Structural schema for services.yml. Cross-field rules the schema cannot express (git-pull needs repo, domain collisions, health needs domain, dot-rule resolution) live in scripts/validate_services.py, not here.

health.description: URL path, must start with a leading slash

published_port_ok.description: Waives the 'no wildcard port next to a domain' rule for this one service. A string, not a boolean: the value is the reason, and the length floor is there so it has to be one. validate_services.py lists every waiver on each run so the exception stays visible instead of becoming the new normal.

base_dir.description: Overrides service_base_dir (ansible group_vars) for this service.

sync.description: compose-pull only: paths inside services/<name>/ that must reach the host next to the compose file, e.g. a sidecar config a volume mounts from ./. Relative to the service directory, no leading/trailing slash, no '..'. The compose file itself is implicit. A path that does NOT exist in the service directory is runtime state and does not belong here; see validate_services.py.

path.description: Directory relative to base_dir, replaces the service name segment. No leading/trailing slash, no '..'.

env_rerender.description: Re-render .env.j2 on EVERY deploy instead of only the first. Only for services whose .env is a pure projection of the controller's environment; a template that GENERATES secrets (lookup('password', ...)) would rotate them on every deploy and must keep the default.

env_from_secrets.description: Render the host .env from the encrypted secrets file instead of from .env.j2, which this takes precedence over. Maps the variable name the compose file or app expects to a reference '[<file>:]<KEY>'. Without a file prefix the key is looked up in secrets/app.env. The file list is an allowlist rather than a free path because the value ends up in REPO_ROOT / <file> inside lookup_plugins/sops_dotenv.py, and pathlib discards the left operand when the right one is absolute. The mapping is explicit on purpose: the compose variable name and the secret key may differ. Re-rendered on every deploy: the encrypted file is the source of truth, so there is nothing to preserve on the host.
